description_en: Describes the address pools of a Global Traffic Manager (GTM) instance
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-gtm-instance-address-pools --lang en --instance-id gtmtest --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGtmInstanceAddressPools

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GTM instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

AddrCount.description_en: The number of addresses in the address pool

AddrPoolId.description_en: The ID of the address pool

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the address pool was created

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the address pool was created

MinAvailableAddrNum.description_en: The minimum number of available addresses in the address pool

MonitorConfigId.description_en: The ID of the health check configuration

MonitorStatus.description_en:
The health check status. Valid values:

OPEN: Health checks are enabled.

CLOSE: Health checks are disabled.

UNCONFIGURED: Health checks are not configured
MonitorStatus.description_zh:
监控状态。其中：

OPEN：开启
CLOSE：关闭
UNCONFIGURED：未配置

Name.description_en: The name of the address pool

Status.description_en:
The availability status of the address pool. Valid values:

AVAILABLE: The address pool is available.

NOT_AVAILABLE: The address pool is unavailable
Status.description_zh:
地址池可用状态：

AVAILABLE：可用
NOT_AVAILABLE：不可用

Type.description_en:
The type of the address pool. Valid values:

IP: IP address

DOMAIN: Domain name
Type.description_zh:
地址池类型：

IP：IP地址
DOMAIN：域名

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the address pool was last updated

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp that indicates when the address pool was last updated

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20

TotalItems.description_en: The total number of entries returned

TotalPages.description_en: The total number of pages returned
